purposes.statement: Help an individual keep in touch with selected people at a personally meaningful frequency and depth, while respecting both people's autonomy.
purposes.intendedChange: More wanted contact and less effort remembering or initiating it.

externals.name: Owner
externals.modeled: The person using the app, their time zone, available attention, goals and accessibility needs
externals.external: Whether to respond and what a relationship means

externals.name: Contacts
externals.modeled: Friends, family and other selected people; some have app accounts and some do not
externals.external: Whether to respond and what a relationship means

externals.name: Relationship context
externals.modeled: Distance, changing routines, communication preferences and welcome or unwelcome contact; record uncertainty

externals.name: Channels
externals.modeled: Calls, meetings, SMS, email and other messaging apps
externals.external: The app cannot infer their delivery or meaning merely by opening them

externals.name: Device
externals.modeled: Browser, device notification permissions and selected files
externals.external: Access to a phone gallery is a later capability

externals.name: Providers
externals.modeled: Identity, notification and optional model providers

externals.name: Events
externals.modeled: Changes in routines, travel, milestones and service outages relevant to contact; record source, time and uncertainty

claims.name: Remembering
claims.mechanism: Private context and a chosen cadence reduce forgetting
claims.indicator: Weekly proportion of active goals satisfied by qualifying contact; denominator excludes paused goals
claims.evaluationMethod: Two-week personal baseline where the user chooses, then a four-week pilot; compare descriptive trends and interview participants
claims.limitation: A before-and-after improvement cannot establish causality

claims.name: Initiating
claims.mechanism: One concrete next action lowers initiation effort
claims.indicator: User-rated effort before and after use
claims.evaluationMethod: Two-week personal baseline where the user chooses, then a four-week pilot; compare descriptive trends and interview participants
claims.limitation: A channel opened is not proof that contact occurred

claims.name: Meaning
claims.mechanism: User-defined depth prompts help contact feel worthwhile
claims.evaluationMethod: Two-week personal baseline where the user chooses, then a four-week pilot; compare descriptive trends and interview participants
claims.limitation: Avoid treating a model's rating as relationship truth

claims.name: Autonomy
claims.mechanism: Adjustable cadence, pauses and recipient consent reduce unwanted pressure
claims.indicator: Notification burden, snoozes, opt-outs and private burden reports
claims.evaluationMethod: Two-week personal baseline where the user chooses, then a four-week pilot; compare descriptive trends and interview participants
claims.limitation: Blocking is not a product failure

claims.name: Updates
claims.mechanism: Consented digest reading provides context for a personal follow-up
claims.indicator: Reader usefulness and subsequent voluntary contact
claims.evaluationMethod: Two-week personal baseline where the user chooses, then a four-week pilot; compare descriptive trends and interview participants
claims.limitation: Passive reading never counts as personal contact by default

description.narrative: The main experience is a purposeful contacts app. People are the organizing unit. Each relationship has an owner-only intention such as “check in every two weeks” or “make room for a proper conversation monthly.” A calm Today view suggests a finite set of next actions. A user can act, log contact, snooze, pause or revise the goal. There are no streak penalties or public relationship scores.
alternatives: Individually addressed updates instead of shared digests
openQuestions: Does “no one-to-many outgoing” prohibit reader-driven digest publication?

nodes.name: People
nodes.description: Exactly PageHeading, SearchInput, AddContact control and ContactCollection. One ContactRow per result; each row has a name and Open control. One AddContactDialog only while invoked, with name, optional channel fields, Save and Cancel

nodes.name: ContactRow
nodes.description: Each row has a name and Open control

nodes.name: AddContactDialog
nodes.description: Name and channel fields, Save and Cancel; Save invokes operation.contact.save

nodes.name: Save
effects: Save only that owner's record; editing does not send invitations
failure: Blank name: keep entered values and render one ErrorSummary
nodes.description: Save is a semantic affordance whether or not its button has been implemented.

nodes.name: Today
nodes.description: Exactly PageHeading, TodayControls and SuggestionCollection; 0–5 cards, or one EmptyState inside the collection.

nodes.name: SuggestionCard

nodes.name: Snooze

nodes.name: Account
nodes.description: ID, identity-provider subject, display name, time zone and notification preferences; one authenticated owner

nodes.name: ContactRecord
nodes.description: ID, ownerAccountId, display name, optional channels and linkedAccountId; belongs to one owner
invariants: Linking it to an Account does not transfer ownership or reveal notes

nodes.name: RelationshipGoal
nodes.description: ID, owner, ContactRecord, intervalDays, desiredDepth, channel, anchorDate, pause and snooze; owner-only

nodes.name: Create or edit private contact
effects: Save only that owner's record; editing does not send invitations
failure: Blank name returns a validation error
Stale version returns conflict without overwriting current data

nodes.name: Save goal
effects: Increment goal version, recompute due state and cancel obsolete jobs

nodes.name: Log or revise contact
effects: Persist event; recompute affected goals without sending anything

nodes.name: Owner-only access
nodes.description: Reads and writes to another owner's private records must return a non-revealing denial.

nodes.name: Explicit pair consent
nodes.description: Creating the invitation and accepting it provide the two consents.

nodes.name: Worker with static assets
nodes.description: Workers with Static Assets; authenticated API and invitation routes run through the Worker

nodes.name: Contacts store (D1)
nodes.description: D1 for accounts, owned contacts, goals, events, consent and jobs

requirements.title: Screens
requirements.text: Authenticated screens must share one AppShell containing exactly TopBar, PrimaryNav and RouteOutlet. PrimaryNav must contain Today, People and Settings.

requirements.title: Operations
requirements.text: All mutations must authorize the authenticated owner or explicit connected capability at the server, validate inputs and support an idempotency key.

requirements.title: Prompts
requirements.text: Today must return at most five suggestions, ordered by effective due date then stable goal ID.

criteria.title: Owner isolation

criteria.title: People screen composition

criteria.title: Save contact

criteria.title: Contact storage
